observations.title: Choose a schematic tool
observations.player_action: Open Litematica's Generic configuration and replace its stick tool setting with the dedicated LitematicaTool item.
observations.outcome: Use a dedicated schematic tool while ordinary sticks retain normal interactions.
conditions: External author documentation is not proof of effective JEM behavior; compare the installed version and configuration before implementation.
This is a tool-item addon, not Litematica itself; exact installed companion availability remains a separate requirement.
observations.review_note: Action completion requires a proven native signal; inventory possession alone does not prove this action. Raw recipe data owner: Catalog/graphs/recipes/litematicatool.json.
